steps.content: You are not Graves's so-called "true love," nor are you some reborn hero from another world seeking revenge. You remember now—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So this ghost story actually originated from the Bureau itself? And what's this <color=#fb9259>picture book</color> they mentioned...?
The shackles haven't fully restored your memories. Instead, they've reawakened your ability to sense the Mania around you, intensifying your headache and worsening your dizziness.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: What's wrong? Why would you hurt me? Why... would you ruin our wedding?

You force yourself to look up despite your discomfort. The bride stands helplessly amid the red light. The instinctive reactions from your shackles were too intense, leaving her with minor injuries. Still holding the ring, her hands now bear scratches from your shackles.
Though you still don't understand how you ended up here, you recognize that this bride is also a victim of her own misguided affections. You withdraw the shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm sorry, but I'm not the one you're supposed to marry...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You must be getting impatient, aren't you? Don't worry, once we put the ring on, it will all be over soon.
Graves ignores your explanation, forcing a smile as she extends the ring toward you once more.
Your honest reaction feels cruel in the face of the scene before you.
The exquisite decorations are shattered by your shackles, fragments scattered across the floor. The bride stands amid this chaos, slightly wounded yet smiling as she awaits your answer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have no idea how I ended up here by accident. I've wasted your time and somehow made those promises with you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm truly sorry for ruining your wedding. I sincerely hope you'll soon find the person who's truly meant for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I'm not the "true love" you've been looking for.
You made yourself perfectly clear. Yet Graves refuses to let go, gripping your wrist tightly.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Why? I worked so hard. I tried to make myself beautiful. I tried to become worthy of this lovely dress. I've found so many friends to attend our wedding... Everything I have, everything I am, belongs to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That belongs to you.
Her grip on your wrist suddenly tightens. She looks up at you as though she's just heard something she cannot understand. Tears begin to fall, one by one, onto the burn scars left by shackles.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No... No... I wasn't wrong. I'm so close. After waiting so long for someone to stand by me, after all the struggle to finally make my dream wedding happen... I'm this close...

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: He doesn't like us? Then what's his type? We can become whatever he wants!
steps.female_content: She doesn't like us? Then what's her type? We can become whatever she wants!

steps.content: Her breathing quickens as your shackles pick up an unsettling pulse. Strange shadows flicker across Graves's body, and unstable Mania begins to surge in the air.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: I'm not good enough. There must be something. Think! Is my hair a mess? Did I wear my veil wrong? Am I too thin? And that most important thing... he can't find out...
steps.female_content: I'm not good enough. There must be something. Think! Is my hair a mess? Did I wear my veil wrong? Am I too thin? And that most important thing... she can't find out...

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: If he finds out, he will hate me, abandon me!
steps.female_content: If she finds out, she will hate me, abandon me!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Graves?
She suddenly jerks away from you, as if shocked by electricity, her body trembling as she wraps her arms tightly around herself.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: All we want is just a wedding. If even that is too much to ask, it must be because we're too terrible!
[Red flash] [Lights out]

A violent wind suddenly erupts, sweeping through the entire hall as the bride before you vanishes into thin air. A moment later, all the lights go off simultaneously, plunging everything around you once more into impenetrable darkness.

Your instincts flare, the shackles tightening in your palm as you prepare for combat.
Yet as seconds tick by... silence envelops you. The danger you anticipated fails to materialize.
The violent wind gradually subsides and the swirling dust begins to settle. In the moonlight not far from you, you see the silhouette of a twisted, monstrous figure that wasn't there before.
She raises her deformed hand, frantically trying to hide her face. The figure in the darkness cowers and trembles uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Don't... don't come near me.
She's a Sinner. And worse... a Sinner on the verge of becoming a Corruptor.
